name: Away mode remembers similar tool calls, and a request waits as long as the project says
description: C-401: a tool call asked in away mode can be allowed once, for similar calls in the session, or always in the project, by Claude Code's suggested rule. Reading a secret always asks. Rules are listed and removable in Settings, and the request timeout is a project and account setting.

steps.title: An away session waits on two tool calls

steps.caption: An unattended Claude Code session asks to run its tests and to read .env.
The project lets such a request wait four hours, so the session waits instead of falling back.

steps.title: Allow similar calls in this session

steps.caption: Besides this call, similar calls can be allowed by Claude Code's suggested rule.
Allow similar in this session: Bash(bun run test:*) until the session ends.

target.text: Approved. Similar calls in this session are allowed from now on.

steps.caption: The next call like it is approved by the rule, without asking, and audited.

target.text: Always asks: touches a secret or credential file

steps.caption: Reading .env is never remembered: deleting files, protected pushes and secrets always ask.

steps.title: Rules and the timeout in project settings

steps.caption: The rule just made is listed with the project rule, each removable and audited.

target.name: Remove the rule Bash(bun run lint:*)

steps.caption: The project's request timeout: from 1 minute to 12 hours, 5 minutes by default.

steps.title: An account timeout for your own sessions

steps.caption: Without a project timeout, your own setting applies, then the 5 minute default.
